thesis: The speaker argues that intelligent investing focuses on auction-driven markets where extreme pricing anomalies, such as a company trading at a fraction of its liquidation value, present clear opportunities. He illustrates this by contrasting the high error rate of trying to predict future stock performance with the certainty of buying assets at prices that make no sense, citing examples like PetroChina and a Turkish warehouse operator.
